$comment: Realtime and push events for Glow (docs/SPEC.md, Events and push). The server sends every event over Realtime to a private channel, and as an Apple push when the event has one. Payloads carry only the event type plus a match or room ID: never a user ID, name, photo or message text (P1, P6). Apps refetch details from the API. Each payload's schema is components.schemas[payloadSchema] in contracts/openapi.yaml, so both generated clients have the type. scripts/codegen.sh checks that the two files agree and generates server/src/contracts/events.ts and ios/Packages/GlowKit/Sources/APIClient/Generated/GlowEvents.swift.

user.audience: Only that person. {userId} is their auth user ID as a lowercase UUID.

room.audience: People with an open check-in in that room. {roomId} is a lowercase UUID.

realtime.$comment: Server side: broadcast to the private channel with event = the event type and payload = the event object. App side: subscribe with private: true. Apps can never send, and presence is never allowed.

push.$comment: APNs payload: { aps: { alert: { body }, sound, category, thread-id, interruption-level }, type, matchId | roomId }. The apns-collapse-id header uses collapseId. The alert body is fixed text and never contains a name.

match.created.description: The second tap lands and a mutual match exists.

push.body: Someone you noticed noticed you back.

match.choice.description: The other person chose Find or Chat, or the match's choosing ended (both chose, the glow couldn't start, or the window ran out). Refetch the match.
match.choice.to: the other person, or both when choosing ends

match.recheck.description: You chose Find and the other person did too, but your location check is older than GEO_FRESHNESS_FOR_GLOW. The app (or a tap on the push, which opens the match) sends Find again with a fresh fix.
match.recheck.to: the person whose location check is stale (set_choice's recheckUserIds, start_glow's staleUserIds)

push.body: Open Glow to find each other.

match.ended.description: The match ended for both people (unmatch, block or account deletion). Close the match and its chat.

glow.started.description: Both chose Find and the glow started.

glow.ended.description: The glow ended: both tapped We met, someone canceled, or time ran out (from purge, or from whichever route reported it in settled).

checkin.expiring.description: This person's check-in ends in CHECKIN_EXPIRY_WARNING or less.

deck.changed.description: Someone in the room paused, left or blocked. Refetch the deck.
